title: Getting Help through WalkMe
body:
Getting Help through WalkMe

The WalkMe Digital Adoption Platform is optional in guided buying. If it is enabled, you can take advantage of easy-to-understand guidance.

Context

If WalkMe is enabled, a question mark icon appears on the pages that are related to the processes for which WalkMe guided tours are available. The following procedure explains how you can use the tour.

Procedure

  1. Click question mark  icon in the window banner.
    The help panel appears.

    If you have both WalkMe and SAP Companion enabled, the panel displays two tabs: Help displays WalkMe content and On-Screen Help displays SAP Companion content.

  2. Select the process for which you want assistance.
  3. An introductory text bubble appears, with a brief description of the process.
  4. Click Next.
  5. Text bubbles with guiding text appear for the main steps of the process to assist you through the process.
    For some UI elements, such as text fields, the bubble automatically moves to the next step as soon as you finish entering the value. In other places, Next and Back navigation buttons are provided.
  6. The tour ends at the end of the process. WalkMe can also suggest the next process to follow.
